chunks: Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Husayn ibn Uthman, who said:
I saw Abu Al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) and he had built a construction at Mina, then demolished it.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Musa al-Kazim do in Mina according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This brief narration from al-Kafi highlights the practical flexibility of Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) in Mina, illustrating his active engagement with the physical spaces of pilgrimage rather than mere ritual observance. The act of building and then demolishing suggests a context of temporary accommodation or adapting to changing circumstances, reflecting the Imam's dynamic leadership during the Abbasid era. It serves as a subtle reminder of the transient nature of worldly structures compared to the enduring spiritual legacy of the Imams.

en.hubeali: Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Husayn Bin Usman who said,
‘I saw Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup> and he<sup>asws</sup> had built a construction at Mina, then demolished it’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ibn abu ‘Umayr has narrated from Husayn ibn ‘Uthman man who has said the following: “
I once saw abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, in Mina where he built a structure, then destroyed it.’”
